[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
When you [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture]sit down[/url] in-game, you will slowly restore stamina with new features.
You can configure the recovery rate and recovery limit up to a specific percentage.

There are similar mods, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7334]Sit For Stamina[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33779]Odd Quality of Life[/url].
However, you still gain stamina when you are tabbed out.

Downloads.Description:
Changed "Energy Recovery Limit" default value to 100% (was previously 50%).
If you're coming back to update the mod, thank you for [b]endorsing[/b]!
